title: dodo Crypto Wealth OS Roadmap Release Plan
description: Human-authored roadmap SoT projected from the Concept implementation order and strategy priority queue. Feature, status, progress, matrix, and graph records remain derived.

time_axis.rationale: Current position is derived from observed Feature and TaskGraph status; future candidate Features stay HIL / Unscheduled until A02 and ownership catalogs exist.

columns.label: Now
columns.description: Running work with an existing SDT Feature or TaskGraph node.

columns.label: Next
columns.description: Approved and unblocked work ready after the current P0 gate.

columns.label: Later
columns.description: Planned work still blocked by dependencies or earlier priority waves.

columns.label: HIL / Unscheduled
columns.description: Candidate Feature IDs or stage changes that still require HIL, A02, or catalog ownership.

work_categories.name: P0-2 Workspace bootstrap
work_categories.summary: Initialize catalog, Roadmap SDT, and standard workflow governance. Existing Feature: F-WORKSPACE-BOOTSTRAP.

work_categories.name: 1. Portfolio dashboard
work_categories.summary: Concept step 1 / P0. Existing Feature: F-CRYPTO-PORTFOLIO-DASHBOARD. Observe-only portfolio and position facts.

work_categories.name: 2. Viability policy core
work_categories.summary: Candidate F-VIABILITY-POLICY-CORE. Machine-checkable viability constraints, Policy, Wallet roles, RiskBudget, optionality, and DRIFTED detection. H1 and H2 remain required.

work_categories.name: 3. World model observation
work_categories.summary: Candidate F-WORLD-MODEL-OBSERVE. Boundary variables, Constraint Graph, and Source trust observations. H1 remains required.

work_categories.name: 4. Opportunity engine
work_categories.summary: Candidate F-OPPORTUNITY-ENGINE. Generate opportunities from World Model and Viability Model differences with Convexity and no-action counterfactual evaluation.

work_categories.name: 5. Guardian RiskSignal
work_categories.summary: Candidate F-GUARDIAN-RISKSIGNAL. Deterministic RiskSignal detection and irreversibility classification without execution.

work_categories.name: 6. Airdrop and claim tracker
work_categories.summary: Candidate F-AIRDROP-CLAIM-TRACKER. Eligibility, deadlines, and claim detection without execution.

work_categories.name: 7. Yield comparison
work_categories.summary: Candidate F-YIELD-COMPARE. Net return and distribution-based comparison; surface APY comparison is prohibited.

work_categories.name: 8. Human-approved execution
work_categories.summary: Candidate F-EXECUTION-APPROVE. Fixed CR-3 pipeline and all gates. Requires H4 and Observe to Approve stage-promotion HIL.

work_categories.name: 9. Limited autonomy through trading
work_categories.summary: Concept steps 8-11 remain frozen. No Feature is created until A02 and the explicit Autopilot stage-promotion HIL.

releases.name: P0 — Foundation and current Observe MVP
releases.summary: Portfolio MVP completion, workspace governance initialization, H1, and Viability A02.

releases.name: P1 — World Model and risk observation
releases.summary: Boundary observations, Opportunity evaluation, and Guardian RiskSignal.

releases.name: P2 — Operational alpha observation
releases.summary: Airdrop/claim tracking and Yield comparison, both without execution.

releases.name: P3 — Approve stage
releases.summary: Human-approved execution after explicit stage-promotion HIL.

releases.name: P4 — Autopilot frozen
releases.summary: Limited autonomy and trading remain out of scope until explicit HIL and A02.
